meta.title: Improve OCaml compiler inference
meta.body_summary: Refine OCaml compiler to emit runtime helpers only when necessary, reducing unnecessary code in the generated OCaml output.

perf_labels.notes: Single-commit compiler optimization reducing OCaml runtime helper emission; merged without review; no performance evidence beyond test output regeneration.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 471 changed lines across 59 files, this is a medium-sized change by absolute volume, but only 58 lines are in the core compiler logic; the rest are test fixture updates. As a compiler optimization, it fits a small-step PR that merged quickly without review.

review_details.concern_detail: No review or discussion was recorded.
review_details.performance_claim: Reduces unnecessary runtime helper emission in generated OCaml code, potentially reducing code size and overhead.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Compiler-level optimization of code generation inference is within agent capability; no review or evidence barriers encountered.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: Test instructions provided to regenerate OCaml test output files; no benchmark or profiling evidence.

core_change_summary.description: In compiler/x/ocaml/compiler.go, refined the inference logic to emit runtime helper functions only when they are actually used, rather than unconditionally. Updated 58 OCaml test output files to reflect the removal of unnecessary helper calls.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: All test file changes are updates to expected output due to the compiler change; no new functionality added.
change_trajectory: Single commit refined helper inference in OCaml compiler and regenerated test outputs.

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened and immediately merged by author with no external review or comments.
